market_question: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?
reasoning: The FY2024 National Defense Authorization Act requires an Act of Congress or Senate approval for NATO withdrawal, eliminating unilateral presidential action. Both parties have strong pro-NATO majorities, making legislative authorization extremely unlikely through 2026. Even under a Trump administration, prior pressure tactics never escalated to formal denunciation, and the strategic costs would be immense.
evidence_points: FY2024 NDAA (passed Dec 2023) mandates congressional approval for any NATO withdrawal.
Bipartisan consensus in Congress opposes NATO exit; even Trump's first term did not attempt formal withdrawal despite rhetoric.
No credible political momentum or official statements signal imminent Article 13 notice; market-implied 8.4% is grossly inflated relative to foundational legal and political barriers.
sources_consulted: Congressional voting records on NATO support (2023-2024)
Historical statements by Trump administration officials on NATO (2017-2021)
Article 13 of the North Atlantic Treaty
